articles.title: Has Patent Term Adjustment Peaked?
articles.content:
由丹尼斯·克劳奇（Dennis Crouch）撰写

今年四月，我曾指出专利期限调整（PTA）仍在上升，且增长趋势没有减缓的迹象。如今，这一增长趋势已趋于平稳。截至2026年5月下旬，新发明专利的PTA六周滚动平均值达到319天的峰值，此后每周保持在305至320天之间。详见丹尼斯·克劳奇，《仍在攀升：PTA达318天，回到2015年水平》，Patently-O（2026年4月21日）。
articles.summary:
by Dennis Crouch

Back in April I wrote that patent term adjustment was still climbing and that the slope showed no sign of leveling. It has now leveled. The six-week trailing average of PTA for newly issued utility patents peaked at 319 days in late May 2026, and has held between 305 and 320 days every week since. See Dennis Crouch, Still Climbing: PTA Hits 318 Days, Back to 2015 Levels, Patently-O (Apr. 21, 2026).
